life.failure_message: There is something seriously amiss with the progression of life...people are aging in reverse!
life.success_message: While there are those that may seek to outmatch the cycle of aging, all is in balance.

water.failure_message: The water is stagnate, it cannot support the thirst of the universe.
water.success_message: Water surges through the mountains and streams, breathing life into every corner of the world.

seasons.failure_message: Seasons stumble and halt, some creatures live in eternal ice, others in barren heat.
seasons.success_message: Seasons turn in flawless rhythm, in tune with the revolution of earth itself.

moon.failure_message: The moon dances with care around the earth, oceans are unstable.
moon.success_message: The moon is bright in the sky, its cycles guide the smallest to largest creatures.

plant.failure_message: The green lifeblood of plants withers. Growth succumbs to decay and the world is fruitless.
plant.success_message: Plants flourish, bringing bounty to the earth.

star.failure_message: Stars dim and fail to form anew, the universe is cold and dead.
star.success_message: Stars blaze throughout the universe, their life cycles provide energy for everything else.

mitosis.failure_message: Cells cannot multiply properly, life fails before it has even begun.
mitosis.success_message: Cells split and multiply with ease, life will succeed!

racecar.failure_message: The racecar engines sputter and fail, their is no need for speed.
racecar.success_message: The roar of the racecars echoe through the land, we are family.

scrolling.failure_message: Humanity seems far more productive with their time than they should be.
scrolling.success_message: Smartphones bring endless hours of content to all!

econ.failure_message: The economy never properly forms. All are equally desitute.
econ.success_message: The cycle of the free market churns smoothly. Its highs and lows bring fortune and famine like clockwork.

frog.failure_message: Tadpoles have no gills and frogs no lungs. The earth is ribbitless.
frog.success_message: The beautiful metamorphosis of tadpoles to frogs is a joy to behold.

rock.failure_message: The earth cannot form its stones. There is only dust.
rock.success_message: Volcanoes erupt and deposit new stones to the earth. Oceans errode away the old. Geology is in harmony.
